patch.value: Route project-schema keys to their declared flags in field refusals

Observed during SDK delivery: update with --field gate_evidence=<JSON> refuses that key as absent from active extension registrations and lists only unrelated extension fields. The same workspace declares gate_evidence as an object field with cli_flag --gate-evidence; schema show-field and update contracts expose it, and the dedicated flag succeeds. Extend field recovery to distinguish configured project-schema fields from extension item fields and provide the executable declared CLI/SDK route. Preserve extension-field admission and no-write refusals. This is a recovery/discovery gap, not a request to bypass schema validation or reinterpret arbitrary extension fields.

A rejected configured schema key names its declared CLI flag and supported SDK route; Unknown extension and reserved core keys retain distinct typed recovery; Native refused-call tests prove unchanged documents/history and execute the advertised correction
An agent can repair the rejected schema-field call using only its refusal and the actual declared field contract.
The gate_evidence refusal names only unrelated active extension fields, while contracts and schema show-field reveal the successful --gate-evidence route.
